messages:
Ava: Quick check — we need to lock owners/dates for the RCA action items before Friday so we can update the release board. I've copied the list below. Please reply with owner + due date. :calendar:

Ava: Actions:
- #1 fallback routing for model OOMs — currently unowned
- #2 dedicated capacity guardrails — infra + deployment changes
- #3 quant eval + threshold for regressions
- #4 postmortem doc edits + mitigations to publish

Jordan: I'll take #1 (fallback routing). ETA Wed 03/17. Need @Marco to confirm capacity for a canary run. :white_check_mark:

Marco: I can own #2 (capacity/guardrails). ETA Fri 03/19. Will run scale tests next Tue. FYI infra window Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00, so scheduling inside that.

Priya: I'll own #3 (quant eval). Need the test model and the runtime patch from eng-runtime — that's currently gated. Blocker until patch lands. Tentative ETA 03/22. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sasha: I'll do #4 (doc + comms). Can publish once fixes merged. ETA 03/20. I'll flag customer-impacting mitigations to GTM.

Ava: Thanks all. @Marco can you confirm the exact time for the scaling test so Jordan can align the canary? @Jordan will you draft the fallback spec and link the PR? I'll update the RCA with owners. :memo:

Marco: Scaling tests scheduled Tue 09:30 in perf-lab. Checklist I'm running:
```
- reserve perf-lab GPUs
- deploy canary model variant
- run 50k token burst at target qps
- monitor OOMs/latency and KV cache hitrate
```

Jordan: Drafted the fallback spec, pushing to https://git.redwood/reports/rca-fallback PR #212. Ping @Priya for any integration notes re: quant path. :link:

Priya: Got the PR link. If the fallback touches KV cache semantics, that'll add ~2d to the work (needs eng-runtime changes). Will update here after I review.

ops-bot: Reminder: RCA doc updated -> https://docs.redwood/rcas/INC-482 (automated snapshot).

Ava: OK, I'll collate these into the action table and set due dates. Final ask — if anyone can't hit their ETA, update this thread by EOD tomorrow so we can reschedule the milestone. :thumbsup:
